During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]], [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], capturing the crucial [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lanes leading to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], all within a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. The capture of the lanes jeopardized the supplies of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] and Kessel [[Spice/Legends|spice]], leading in civilian misery once the supply shortage was felt, and also prevented the Mon Calamari from performing an "ages-old ritual."<ref name="Wild Space" />
